new_claim.statement: For a full-column original-coordinate carrier M with G=M^TM and arbitrary added physical action N, let B=G^{-1/2}M^TNG^{-1/2}=H+K, D=I+H. For rho>0, let q be the dimension of the D-spectrum in (-rho,rho), and nu=||B^TB-BB^T||. Then ||P_+ K P_-||<=nu/(4rho) and s_{m-q}(M+N)>=s_m(M)(rho-nu/(4rho))_+. An additional coefficient tail of norm delta subtracts at most delta. The proof uses B^TB-BB^T=2[D,K] and a Sylvester integral across the +/- rho spectral gap, then the completed account02/B12 cross-sign skew shield at r=0.

After a globally dense signed small-spectrum packet of norm <=1/64, the actual final cross block has s5>=111/64; hence ||p_Q||_infinity<=320 sqrt(2e)/111<6.722 and the scoped density has a continuous C0 representative.
